AS "venueName", e.term_note AS "termNote", e.cast_alternation AS "castAlternation", COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM catalog.event_seats s WHERE s.event_id = e.id), ?), (SELECT COALESCE(sum(total_qty), ?) FROM catalog.ticket_types t WHERE t.event_id = e.id))::int AS capacity, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT ? FROM catalog.event_seats s WHERE s.event_id = e.id) THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog.event_seats s WHERE s.event_id = e.id AND s.status = ?) ELSE (SELECT COALESCE(sum(total_qty - remaining_qty), ?) FROM catalog.ticket_types t WHERE t.event_id = e.id) END::int AS sold, (COALESCE(e.sales_end_at, e.date_start) > now()) AS "salesOpen", e.production_id AS "productionId", e.title FROM catalog.events e JOIN catalog.venues v ON v.id = e.venue_id WHERE e.status = ? AND e.date_start > now() ORDER BY lower(v.city), e.date_start LIMIT ?

FROM catalog.ticket_types t WHERE t.event_id = e.id))::int AS capacity, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT ? FROM catalog.event_seats s WHERE s.event_id = e.id) THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog.event_seats s WHERE s.event_id = e.id AND s.status = ?) ELSE (SELECT COALESCE(sum(total_qty - remaining_qty), ?) FROM catalog.ticket_types t WHERE t.event_id = e.id) END::int AS sold, (COALESCE(e.sales_end_at, e.date_start) > now()) AS "salesOpen" FROM catalog.events e LEFT JOIN catalog.venues v ON v.id = e.venue_id WHERE e.production_id = $1 AND e.status = ? AND e.date_start > now() ORDER BY e.date_start
